contractAndRulingCompliance: apps/desktop/src/shared/personal-office/** remains read-only and is the contract of record.
PERSONAL_OFFICE_SCHEMA_VERSION is the sole persisted schema authority; WORK_SCHEMA_VERSION and shared/work-model.ts are not used by the engine.
failed remains terminal; retry and fork create new runs with explicit lineage.
legacy blocked maps to paused, never failed.
legacy archived outcomes require structured terminal evidence; inconclusive archives become canceled with canceledReason=legacy_archived_outcome_unknown.
archivedAt and legacyStatusRaw are preserved, and migration conclusion events are first-write-wins with exactly one idempotency key.
canonical action hashing binds the exact redacted value that is persisted for both request-time and edit-time approvals.

filesChangedFromBase.summary: 21 created work-engine modules/tests and 3 modified wired seams; sqlite-schema.ts was leased but intentionally unchanged.

surfaces: approval secrets and immutable action binding
controls: Every preload operation requires an explicit workspaceId.
Main resolves current identity for each operation; renderer identity claims are never trusted.
Tenant workspace bindings include reviewerHash and cannot survive a user switch.
Event history is filtered in SQL by workspace and live events pass a mandatory main-process visibility predicate plus an exact preload workspace filter.
Work-model backup runs before first work DDL; migration failure closes the DB and prevents IPC/window startup.
Future schema versions throw UnsupportedWorkModelVersionError before backup or DDL.
Approval request and edit inputs pass one redaction boundary whose output is used for hashing and persistence.
Dynamic SQL assignment names come only from fixed source literals; all values remain parameterized.
